title: Pregnant Trio #49
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. THREE women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Japanese, in her late 30s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — a stunning hourglass figure carrying a full-term pregnancy, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward well past her own chest, the navel pushed slightly outward, and below the belly her hips flare wide and curvaceous. Her waistline has fully given way to the pregnancy's round, taut curve, no sharp cinch at the middle, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a deep bronze tan foundation over real skin, thick white paint bands above and below both eyes lying on the lids and never across the eyeballs, neon pink and lime paint strokes across the cheekbones, rhinestone and star stickers clustered on the cheeks and forehead only, long false lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy white lips, long teased neon-pink and lime hair, a fierce, playful expression, curly hair, real pores, real living eyes, 8 clicker rings piercings set with diamonds in bronze-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold earrings. Painted in Chinese Cizhou sgraffito ceramic, a glossy jet-black glaze carved to cream-white peony scrolls, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide carved cream bands curving fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the densest concentration of leaf scrolls wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, extreme carved cream extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#3: American, in her mid 40s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
